title: Macbeth Curriculum
summary: The whole play, act by act, for grades 9–12: Shakespeare’s text with a modern version beside it, quick checks, written responses and a final essay.

steps.caption: The student view. Five acts, a scene at a time, with grades shown as they go.
Shakespeare’s original text, with line numbers.
One click puts a modern-English version beside it.
A quick check after every scene scores itself.
Then a written response with evidence. It saves as they type.

steps.text: The witches meet in a storm, which tells us the play will be about chaos. They plan to meet Macbeth, so his fate seems decided before he even appears.

steps.caption: The teacher dashboard. Every act and every part of the essay is a tile.
Written responses, scene by scene, with the rubric on screen.

steps.text: Good link between the storm and the chaos to come. Quote the line that shows it.

steps.caption: Scores and comments save on their own. Push grades to Canvas when you’re ready.
